title: Identification of Estradiol Benzoate as an Inhibitor of HBx Using Inducible Stably Transfected HepG2 Cells Expressing HiBiT Tagged HBx.
authors: He, Jingjing; Wu, Jingwen; Chen, Jingwen; Zhang, Shenyan; Guo, Yifei; Zhang, Xueyun; Han, Jiajia; Zhang, Yao; Guo, Yue; Lin, Yanxue; Yu, Weien; Kong, Yide; Shen, Zhongliang; Mao, Richeng; Zhang, Jiming
one_liner_zh: 该文筛选HBx抑制剂并做分子对接，但对象为病毒蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: HBx plays a significant role in the cccDNA epigenetic modification regulating the hepatitis B virus (HBV) life cycle and in hepatocyte proliferation and carcinogenesis. By using the sleeping-beauty transposon system, we constructed a tetracycline-induced HBx-expressing stable cell line, SBHX21. HBx with a HiBiT tag can be quickly detected utilizing a NanoLuc-based HiBiT detection system. By screening a drug library using SBHX21 cells, we identified estradiol benzoate as a novel anti-HBx agent. Estradiol benzoate also markedly reduced the production of HBeAg, HBsAg, HBV pgRNA, and HBV DNA in a dose-dependent manner, suggesting that estradiol benzoate could be an anti-HBV agent. Docking model results revealed that estradiol benzoate binds to HBx at TRP87 and TRP107. Collectively, our results suggest that estradiol benzoate inhibits the HBx protein and HBV transcription and replication, which may serve as a novel anti-HBV molecular compound for investigating new treatment strategies for HBV infection.
abstract_zh: HBx在cccDNA表观遗传修饰调控乙型肝炎病毒（HBV）生命周期以及肝细胞增殖和癌变中发挥重要作用。通过使用睡美人转座子系统，我们构建了四环素诱导的HBx表达稳定细胞系SBHX21。带有HiBiT标签的HBx可利用基于NanoLuc的HiBiT检测系统快速检测。通过使用SBHX21细胞筛选药物库，我们鉴定出雌二醇苯甲酸酯为一种新型抗HBx药物。雌二醇苯甲酸酯还以剂量依赖性方式显著减少了HBeAg、HBsAg、HBV pgRNA和HBV DNA的产生，表明雌二醇苯甲酸酯可能是一种抗HBV药物。对接模型结果显示，雌二醇苯甲酸酯在TRP87和TRP107位点与HBx结合。总体而言，我们的结果表明，雌二醇苯甲酸酯抑制HBx蛋白及HBV转录和复制，这可能作为一种新型抗HBV分子化合物，用于研究HBV感染的新治疗策略。
